tenderSchedule.title: Work of Construction of 5.0 ML Capacity RCC GLR which is feeding Kaval Byrasandra and other surrounding areas located at Pulkeshinagar Bangalore
tenderSchedule.description: Construction of 5ML GLR along with pipeline works
tenderSchedule.deptName: Bengaluru Water Supply And Sewerage Board

tenderAddress.blockNumber: office of EIC 2nd floor cauvery bhavan

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All conditions as per tender document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer as prime contractor should have satisfactorily completed during the last five years at least one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work value not less than Rs: 996.45 lakhs (Constructed & commissioned GLR with allied works). (If the contract contains many components all components need to be completed)

The contractor should have constructed and commissioned of 4 ML capacity and above RCC water retaining reservoir with RCC roof along with supply, laying, commissioning of 300mm and above rising DI main pipeline work of 3000 rmt

Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work: RCC of M30 with shuttering 2,863 cum, Earth work Excavation 1,312 Cum, TMT steel 250 MT, Supply, installation of commissioning of 300mm and above dia DI pipeline 2,816 rmt Supply installation and commissioning of EMF meters of 400 mm dia and above 2 Nos
Should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 3985.78 lakh.
Liquid assets or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.332.00 Lakhs (usually the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for the three months in the peak construction period.
